scene1_screen1.text: Night crowds a narrow deer-track. Trees loom like blackened pillars, and a chalk-white mist snakes over mossy roots. In every direction, the undergrowth clutches at boots and hems.

scene1_screen2.text: Elara’s lantern sputters. She stops, senses prickling: the forest has gone suddenly, perfectly still.

scene1_screen3.text: Shadow-wolves glide from the fog – five of them, with pelts the color of spilled ink, eyes glowing milky white.

scene1_screen4.text: Elara sets her stance. A dagger flashes silver in her fist. From the shadows, a low snarl creeps in – Hhhssssssss-rrr…The wolf pack is near.

scene1_screen5.text: A brighter flash – steel on shadow. Wolves yelp and scatter as a tall stranger swings an iron longsword that thrums like a tuning fork struck in anger.

scene1_screen6.text: He plants himself in front of Elara, cloak flaring, then turns. Lantern-light shows his stubbled jaw, a fresh cut across his cheek, eyes deep and powered with adrenaline.

scene1_screen7.text: (steady, low) They hate iron. And fire. You’ve one; I’ve the other.

scene1_screen8.text: (keeping the dagger up) Who are you?

scene1_screen9.text: (crooked half-smile) Tonight? The reason you’re still breathing.

scene1_screen10.text: He offers a calloused hand; Elara doesn’t take it. The forest creaks overhead, disappointed its hunt is stalled.

scene1_screen11.text: (gentler) Careful. The pack will circle back. Roads twist when you walk alone – let me guide you out.

scene1_screen12.text: (arching a brow) Guide, ghost, or trap? I’ve met all three in these woods.

scene1_screen13.text: (shrugs, sheathing sword) Maybe all three. But I swung at the wolves, not you.

scene1_screen14.text: A distant howl rises; the ground trembles as something huge shifts in the dark.

scene1_screen15.text: (quickly) What do you want in return?

scene1_screen16.text: (shrugs again) A name would be fair trade.

scene1_screen18.text: Caspian. Pleasure, Elara – though it’s not the best place to meet.

scene1_screen19.text: A fresh rustle – smaller shadows scuttling along the underbrush.

scene1_screen20.text: (urgent whisper) Decision time. Talk on the move or bleed standing still.

scene1_screen21.text: (steady but wary) Your timing was perfect – my thanks. Point me east at first light and we part ways.

scene1_screen22.text: Elara’s gaze locks on the vacant setting of the talisman at Caspian’s throat. Her lore tells of four wild relics, brewed beneath starlight, that fuse into a single soul-stone – a perfect fit for that empty clasp. She glances away thinking.

scene1_choice1.text: How do you greet the stranger?

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (curt nod) Gratitude accepted. Keep your blade loose; these woods change sides fast.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: He strides ahead, carving a silent corridor with his sword. Elara follows at measured distance; their silence hums with calculation rather than trust.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Those wolves could return with friends. We need to get out of here at speed.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen4.text: A branch snaps somewhere unseen; both reach for weapons in the same breath.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Their silence is not empty – it hums with calculations of threat, direction, and escape. Each step a vow to reach dawn beyond these choking woods, free of any tether.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (relieved exhale) Then walk with me. A shorter story makes a safer trail – and the safest trail is the one no map knows.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: They set off at pace, lantern and iron casting overlapping halos – an uneasy trust. The forest briefly holds their mingled glow before surrendering it to fog.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen4.text: These oaks remember debts. Mine are paid in sweat and stories.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: (half-teasing) Stories strong enough to reroute roots?

scene1_choice1_option2_screen6.text: (smiling) Strong enough that the forest asked for a sequel. Tonight might be chapter one.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen7.text: (hushed) Make it worth the sequel’s ink.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen8.text: Shoulders brush in quiet promise. The fog parts like a curtain, the woods await their unfolding story.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (twinkling eyes) Perfect timing, stylish rescue – shall I charge a dance as my fee?

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Their shared laugh eclipses their fading fears.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (lower voice) Careful – these trees get jealous of guests worth keeping around.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (brow raised, teasing) Then prove I’m worth stealing. I’m good at slipping leashes.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Laughter sparks like fireflies as they step into deeper shadows.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: Fair warning: follow me, and we’ll be utterly lost together.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen7.text: I hope these woods let us leave.

scene1_screen23.text: Their first words spent, they fall into a wary march through knotted undergrowth.

scene1_screen24.text: Each new shadow feels like the forest tightening its grip – there must be a way out.

scene2_screen1.text: As they move ahead, every cedar they pass leans eastward, as if pointing to the forest’s distant edge. Caspian knows these woods, yet even he’s lost his bearings.

scene2_screen2.text: The fear of wolves ebbs away. They stop briefly so Elara can balm and bandage a fresh cut on Caspian’s arm. He watches her steadiness, never once flinching.

scene2_screen3.text: Every few steps, a hollow knock rolls through the grove – branch on bark, or unseen knuckles tapping a coded invitation. It seems something wants to enter – or invite them inside.

scene2_screen4.text: Those knocks again – three short, two long. A warning?

scene2_screen5.text: (dry smile) Or the forest welcoming us. It has ironic timing.

scene2_screen6.text: (soft laugh) Perfect. I’m not great with bravery; irony’s worse.

scene2_screen7.text: Caspian and Elara tread carefully, senses keen as hunted deer, unsure what forces lurk ahead.

scene2_screen8.text: (checking dagger) We could answer the knock, see who’s home.

scene2_screen9.text: (raising brow) Or slip past and leave whoever’s home lonely, unfed.

scene2_screen10.text: (voice soft) Choices taste sweeter when you’re still breathing after.

scene2_screen11.text: A cedar root rises, forcing them shoulder-to-shoulder; blades clash accidentally, echoing like a dinner bell. They share a silent glance in the darkness.

scene2_screen12.text: From deeper in the grove, a sudden knock – louder than before – cracks the stillness, then fades. Guided by a faint glow, they approach a lightning-split cedar.

scene2_screen13.text: Within the split trunk rests a luminous wooden shard veined like a compass rose: the Heart-Wood Sliver, said to draw moon-silver into any potion brewed beneath starlight.

scene2_choice1.text: Decide how to take the Heart-Wood Sliver.

opts.text: Take it openly and knock back
Scout for ambush, grab Sliver later
Whisper to the trees & take it secretly

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Elara reaches into the split trunk and lifts the glowing Sliver, holding it high for Caspian to see, then strikes the bark twice with the hilt of her dagger. Silence swells; trees lean in, fog freezes mid-swirl.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (low, half-impressed) You just told the forest you’re not afraid. Let’s hope it believes you.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (shrugs) I was raised to answer invitations.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: A long groan overhead – the canopy parts, revealing a narrow tunnel of roots and bark.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (wary) The forest’s listening now. Stay close.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen6.text: They step inside. The Sliver in Elara’s pouch glows warmer, like a second heartbeat pressed to hers. The Sliver tugs faintly east – one of four keys between them and the forest’s border.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Elara studies claw marks spiraling up the trunk – some deep, some new.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (softly) These aren’t random. Someone tried to ward off whatever’s inside.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Or warn us not to take it.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: She waits, watching. Only when the forest seems to exhale again does she ease the Sliver free and slip it into her cloak.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: (lowering his voice) Sure it’s not cursed?

scene2_choice1_option2_screen6.text: If it is, it already knows our names.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen7.text: They move on. The mist thickens, but the Sliver vibrates like a needle tugged toward a hidden thread.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Elara lays her palm on the wood. It pulses once, whispering in a tongue only memory understands: “Memory for direction.” A name slips from her mind – hers, or someone else’s, she can’t tell.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Caspian’s gaze is elsewhere; she pockets the Sliver unseen.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Fog churns at their feet. A faint silver thread appears ahead, visible only when she doesn’t look directly at it.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (carefully neutral) We should move – before the next knock is less polite.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen6.text: They follow the shifting thread. Elara scores a half-remembered rune into the nearest trunk as they pass.

scene2_screen14.text: The ground trembles gently. Moss-covered roots pull aside as the earth splits open, revealing a steep passage into darkness. Pebbles slip silently into the gap and vanish.

scene2_screen15.text: Elara’s hand tightens on the Sliver. For one breathless moment, visions shimmer – a coiling serpent, frost blooming on stone, a rune of silver dust. Each pulses like a memory she hasn’t lived.

scene2_screen16.text: (low, to herself) There are four pieces…bound together…fated.

scene2_screen18.text: (quiet) Not saw – remembered. This isn’t just chance. We’re meant to walk this path.

scene2_screen19.text: They trade a silent look, raise their lanterns, and step into the waiting dark – unaware of what watches from beneath.

scene2_screen20.text: (softly) I fear the forest has more in store before it lets us go.

scene3_screen1.text: Caspian’s mind flicks to the old forest charts he’s memorized: this chasm marks the map’s last inked boundary – beyond its far rim, the tunnel climbs toward daylight.

scene3_screen2.text: Elara and Caspian tumble onto a mossy ledge overlooking a seething carpet of serpents below. Hundreds knot together, their hisses mingling with damp echoes beneath a bridge that looks one step from collapse.

scene3_screen3.text: (steady crouch) That bridge is a death drop; snakes think we’re dinner.

scene3_screen4.text: (eyeing ropes) Planks might hold one at a time. Two would guarantee doom.

scene3_screen5.text: (testing tension) Knots look like betrayal. One shift of weight means death.

scene3_screen6.text: (grim humor) Torches could buy breathing room. Snakes hate flame.

scene3_screen7.text: (sudden focus) Wait. I’ve got something better.

scene3_screen8.text: She kneels, pulling a thin pouch from her belt. Fingers blur – powdered rue, crushed nettle, and a pinch of valerian. A sharp herbal scent rises as she scatters the mix across the ledge.

scene3_screen9.text: A silver mist unfurls – low, shimmering, unnatural. Below, the serpents recoil, swaying in confusion, eyes clouding.

scene3_screen10.text: (whispering) Rue for sight. Nettle for nerves. Forget us.

scene3_screen11.text: (low, stunned) You just silenced a pit of snakes.

scene3_screen12.text: They step onto the bridge. Boards creak, but the mist holds, and snakes stay dazed. Each plank threatens to snap, yet their steps are slow and light – shadows in fog.

scene3_screen13.text: Near the final span, a single serpent lashes upward from the shadows – jaws wide. Caspian’s sword arcs; the serpent’s head drops. Elara shudders, shocked.

scene3_screen14.text: A soft green glow pulses inside the dead snake. Elara crouches and retrieves a small, glowing emerald shard – the Serpent’s Eye. Two shards now echo in her pack, their pull stronger, both pointing the same way out.

scene3_screen15.text: (holding the shard) It’s said to ward off deception and venom.

scene3_screen16.text: (dry humor) Would’ve loved that thirty seconds ago.

scene3_screen17.text: They reach the far edge. Hissing fades; mist thins out. For the first time in hours, the cavern is still.

scene3_screen18.text: Breaths steady, muscles ease. They share a look – relief laced with something unspoken, finally lifting. Beyond the cavern mouth, dawn’s grey light hints at a way out – if the forest allows it.

scene3_choice1.text: What do you do after the terror subsides?

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Caspian gently flicks moss and grit from Elara’s hair, his touch precise. Warmth spreads between them, smoothing the ragged edge of fear.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (half-smile, voice low) One rescue at a time.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Caspian uncaps his flask and offers it. As Elara drinks, torch-glow reflects in their eyes; his fingers briefly graze hers.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (steady gaze, voice quiet) And tomorrow – if we walk it side by side.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: He tightens the cap, stows the flask, then brushes a damp strand of hair from her cheek. Their eyes meet – an unspoken promise of trust rather than haste – before both turn to the darkness ahead.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Caspian steps closer, his eyes meeting Elara’s with a question unspoken. In the flickering torchlight, her breath catches—but she nods, slow and sure. He draws her into his arms, careful yet certain, and their bodies find stillness in each other. Their heartbeats sync like twin drums calming a storm.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (murmuring softly) A stillness I could live in… if you’re the one holding it.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (voice gentle, intimate) Then let this breath… this warmth… be our shelter — here, between the shadows.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: She melts into him, the cold cave forgotten, the scent of moss and iron giving way to the quiet thrum of closeness. His hand finds the curve of her back; hers lingers at his collarbone, fingers splayed over the place where the talisman rests — pulsing, just like his chest beneath.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (barely a whisper) If only every moment felt this safe…with you, it just might.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen6.text: He brushes a strand of hair from her cheek, fingertips lingering longer than they need to. Her lips part, but no words come — only the soft exhale of someone letting down armor they’ve worn too long.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (half smile, soft) Careful… you’ll have me believing in fairytales again.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen8.text: (smiling, voice low) Then let’s rewrite one. One where no one has to wake up alone.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen9.text: Their foreheads rest together, eyes closed, the rest of the world suspended. For one breathless instant, the forest holds its breath too. No monsters, no curses, no missions. Just two people, bruised but not broken, choosing warmth in a place made of cold.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen10.text: Their embrace deepens — not out of desperation, but out of recognition. A quiet sanctuary, built not of stone, but trust. And something deeper stirs — not magic, not prophecy, but the kind of longing that chooses to stay.

scene3_screen20.text: The small gesture of support awakened in each of them a feeling that this adventure was becoming more important to them.

scene3_screen21.text: They slip through a narrow cavern exit, leaving the scent of serpents behind. The air hits cold and sharp – a sudden slap of winter…

scene4_screen1.text: Rumour says this clearing guards the halfway mark; beyond the ice, daylight touches open ground.

scene4_screen2.text: Elara and Caspian emerge into razor cold, ice crunching under boots as the forest seals behind, snuffing their lantern.

scene4_screen3.text: At the clearing’s heart, a stone pedestal bears a frozen lily, its diamond petals shimmering like trapped starlight.

scene4_screen4.text: (hugging cloak) Winter ambushed us – it was swamp moments ago.

scene4_screen5.text: (rubbing arms) The forest mood-swings faster than a startled hare.

scene4_screen6.text: (warming hands) Cold reveals truths; warmth hides sins kindly.

scene4_screen7.text: (tilting head) This flower could be lock, key, or both.

scene4_screen8.text: A silence heavier than snow settles on the clearing. Their breath fogs; nerves tighten.

scene4_screen9.text: (checking horizon) No footprints but ours – stage set, no audience.

scene4_screen10.text: (whispering) Feels like we walked into a question waiting for an answer.

scene4_screen12.text: Ice beneath their feet pulses as they approach the lily. They sense the pedestal hides the next relic – the Frostcore Crystal – beneath frozen petals and ancient ice.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Elara darts forward; ice fractures under her fingertips; splinters glittering in moonlight.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: With controlled speed, she lifts the lily; beneath rests the Frostcore Crystal, steaming softly in her palm.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Elara brushes away snow, uncovering iron loops concealed like hinges.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Patiently she finds a hidden compartment and slides out the Frostcore Crystal, pristine and cold as moonstone.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Together, they cradle the frozen lily between their palms. Caspian’s hands close gently over Elara’s — rough and warm, steady as a promise. Her skin, cold from the frost, drinks in his heat like the first light after a long night.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Their joined warmth seeps into the petals, coaxing the ice to soften. Mist curls upward in silvery wisps, as though the flower exhales in relief.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (thinking) He’s so close… and not just in body. How did someone so silent become the only thing keeping me steady?

scene4_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Within the shifting mist, faint threads of light twist and turn — like woven stories, like futures not yet chosen. Each shimmer pulses in time with their joined breath.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (thinking) I’ve walked through fog and blood, but I’ve never held a moment this clear. Her presence… it makes the path feel real.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (quietly, amazed) Paths braided by choice — ours to weave together.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen8.text: The mist brushes against their cheeks, tender as a blessing. Their eyes meet, not searching, but recognizing. Elara’s lips part slightly — not to speak, but to feel. Her heart beats faster, and not from cold.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen9.text: (hopeful whisper) Then let’s choose beautifully. I feel our energy as one.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen10.text: Their fingers interlace without thought, like they’ve done it a hundred times before — or in dreams neither dared speak of. The warmth blooming between them deepens, not just from touch but from something older, wordless, magnetic. His thumb traces a slow circle over her knuckle. She leans a breath closer.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen11.text: (thinking) If I believed in fate, I’d say she’s mine. But what I feel now… it's stronger than fate. It’s a decision. Mine. Ours.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen12.text: The ice melts completely. In the hollow left behind, nestled in their shared grasp, the Frostcore Crystal awakens — pulsing softly with a glow that mirrors their touch. It hums between them, steady and certain.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen13.text: This isn’t just magic. This is invitation — to trust, to move forward, not alone.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen14.text: (barely audible, like a vow) Let this be the beginning... not just of escape, but of us.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen15.text: Around them, the clearing holds its breath — as if the very forest recognizes a bond deeper than any curse it once cast.

scene4_screen13.text: Silver mist swirls; the ice mirror flashes wolf-thrones, candle rivers, blood-red dawns.

scene4_screen14.text: The Frostcore Crystal hums – said to unlock frozen truths and preserve lost memories. Three relics are gathered; dawn feels nearer, though the path grows colder and stranger.

scene4_screen15.text: (intrigued) Clarity against illusion – prophecies tax you twice for guessing wrong.

scene4_screen16.text: (steady breath) We’ve spent tomorrow; may as well wager high.

scene4_screen17.text: (soft grin) High stakes suit stubborn hearts.

scene4_choice2_option1_screen1.text: Ghostly footprints light a path ahead, coaxing them onwards.

scene4_choice2_option1_screen3.text: (resolute) They chose us – trust the guide.

scene4_choice2_option1_screen4.text: The phantom footprints stop at the edge of a frozen lake, awaiting their next decision.

scene4_choice2_option2_screen1.text: Steel meets crystal; blue flames spiral outward.

scene4_choice2_option2_screen2.text: (breathless) Truth or ruin – what did we free?

scene4_choice2_option2_screen4.text: Ice cracks wide, revealing hidden runes blazing beneath.

scene4_choice2_option3_screen1.text: Hand in hand, they chant ancient words; snowflakes rise, forming golden sigils.

scene4_choice2_option3_screen2.text: (low chant, softly) Stone to story, frost to flow…

scene4_choice2_option3_screen3.text: (repeating gently) Write us safe where moonlight goes…

scene4_choice2_option3_screen4.text: (adding harmony, voice bright) Curse to echo, echo to hush, let dawn remember we passed in trust.

scene4_choice2_option3_screen5.text: The granite plinth sighs; a warm, liquid path threads from their boots to the trees.

scene4_choice2_option3_screen6.text: (soft laugh) Seems the clearing prefers composers to conquerors.

scene4_screen18.text: They follow the path down; stone replaces ice beneath their feet.

scene4_screen19.text: Northern lights bloom, mirroring across every surface until the horizon has no seam.

scene4_screen20.text: Elara squeezes Caspian’s gloved hand – small warmth anchoring them against the vast sky.

scene4_screen21.text: A trumpet-like howl echoes far off – celebration or warning, impossible to read – jolting urgency back into their veins.

scene4_screen22.text: (voice steady) If that’s applause, the curtain call is near; let’s move.

scene4_screen23.text: (nodding hard) Applause or predators, both spur speed – let’s be quick.

scene4_screen24.text: (resolute grin) Let’s walk like we mean it.

scene5_screen1.text: This glade sits on the forest’s brim – one cursed circle away from freedom’s first dawn.

scene5_screen2.text: Warm metal tang replaces frost; Elara and Caspian enter a hollow where every heartbeat echoes twice – one bold, one afraid. Soft chanting coils above cracked columns.

scene5_screen3.text: At the glade’s center a broken well bleeds dull gold, pulsing like an infected wound.

scene5_screen4.text: (hand on hilt) Heat feels nice; the smell screams danger – never trust fragrant nightmares.

scene5_screen6.text: Caspian steps and a skull shatters, fireflies burst. Elara recoils.

scene5_screen7.text: (uneasy) Tea and safety sound perfect now.

scene5_screen9.text: Golden visions swirl inside the well – blurred futures, half-remembered pasts.

scene5_screen10.text: (in awe) It shows what could be – and what we lost.

scene5_screen11.text: (tense, cautious) Visions guide or trap. Careful.

scene5_screen12.text: (steady) Whatever it reveals, we face together. I won’t lose myself.

scene5_screen13.text: She begins an ancient chant; light blooms from her fingertips. Shadows hiss and scatter.

scene5_screen14.text: (watchful, amazed) Whatever you’re doing – it’s working!

scene5_screen15.text: (focused, confident) Stay close; the chant won’t hold forever.

scene5_screen16.text: The well shudders, the gold spirals downward. With a final note, the ground trembles and a spiral staircase unfurls into the depths.

scene5_screen17.text: If this stair truly runs east, daylight may lie at its end.

scene5_screen20.text: Caspian’s next step crushes a skull. From the broken shards emerges a black coin peppered with silver dust – the Midnight Rune. It hums in the same key as Elara’s chant.

scene5_screen21.text: (awed) The Midnight Rune – legend says it can rewrite fate.

scene5_screen22.text: (wary) Sounds risky, but maybe what we need.

scene5_screen23.text: Elara presses the Rune into his palm.

scene5_screen24.text: The golden mist tightens, recoiling – and suddenly, the air empties as something massive stirs. A rush of energy has been unleashed.

scene5_screen25.text: Caspian draws his sword sensing incalculable, immediate danger. The air crackles and a horned beast takes shape, immense and powerful, eyes burning with hunger.

scene5_screen26.text: (roaring) AAARRRR! The Rune awakens debt. I’ve come to collect.

scene5_choice1.text: How do you confront the monster?

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Caspian meets the beast head-on, determined to fight with everything he’s got.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: The impact of the first clash nearly throws him backward. His grip tightens on the hilt as the monster’s claws carve sparks off the blade. Each strike costs him breath, each block rattles his bones.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (resolute) If it’s my life or yours, beast – I choose mine.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (supportive, urgent) Stay strong, Caspian! I’m right behind you.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Steel clashes against monstrous claws, neither side giving ground easily. Caspian strikes swiftly, his blade carving through darkness, the beast roaring in pain and fury.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Caspian swiftly dodges, keeping distance to find the perfect opening.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (strategically) Stay clear and watch its movements!

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (alert, tense) Careful – its reach is longer than it looks!

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Caspian glides around the creature with poise, striking quick, precise blows, but every near-miss skirts disaster.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Once, its claw grazes his shoulder, tearing leather and nearly drawing blood. Sweat blurs his vision as the beast whirls, snarling with growing rage.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Caspian nods confidently at Elara, signaling for a powerful magical strike.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (encouragingly) Now, Elara – show it your strength!

scene5_choice1_option3_screen4.text: With a fierce chant, Elara summons an intense burst of magic. The air thickens, her voice straining as energy crackles painfully along her arms.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen5.text: The beast howls, resisting, thrashing wildly. Caspian seizes the opening, surging forward to strike with everything they have left, sending it sprawling back, finally defeated.

scene5_screen27.text: The beast collapses heavily, destroyed and silent. As they catch their breath, the eerie calm returns briefly, yet they remain wary, aware the forest may yet hold more threats.

scene5_screen28.text: With the immediate threat gone, the spiral staircase awaits them, descending into shadowy depths below. If this tunnel truly runs east, daylight may finally breach the treeline.

scene5_screen29.text: (quietly confident) The path is clear now.  I feel we’re close. Quickly, before something else wakes up.

scene5_screen30.text: (steady, supportive) Right behind you. Let’s find what awaits below.

scene5_screen31.text: Carefully, they step onto the ancient stone steps, winding downward.

scene5_screen32.text: Torchlight flickers across carved walls, the air growing cool and silent as they leave the cursed glade behind, entering the mysterious depths of the tunnel.

scene5_screen33.text: (softly) It’s cramped here. Legends walk upright, never crawling.

scene5_screen36.text: Elara lids her hand, fingertips brushing Caspian’s cheek, warmth blooming where she touches.

scene5_screen37.text: (warm smile) Then let me walk beside you, legend.

scene5_screen38.text: Caspian leans softly into her touch, eyes reflecting a quiet, vulnerable affection, deeper than words could ever say.

scene6_screen1.text: The tunnel exhales them into cold clarity. After so much weight, the sky feels impossibly wide. They gulp the first clean breath since night began.

scene6_screen2.text: At the cliff’s edge stands a granite slab, carved with living constellations. Fireflies drift over dusky grass, their glow reflecting on Caspian’s battered armor.

scene6_screen3.text: Behind them, the forest lies quiet at last; ahead, open country stretches unclaimed.

scene6_screen4.text: (hugging herself) Snakes, whispers, ice… we collect themed nightmares.

scene6_screen5.text: (wiping sweat) Let’s upgrade our dreams. Look up.

scene6_screen6.text: (half-smile) Close enough to borrow their light?

scene6_screen7.text: (soft grin) Or let them judge our mud and panic.

scene6_screen8.text: (teasing) Then we’d better impress them by surviving dawn.

scene6_screen9.text: (quiet) Three trails – north to kingdoms, west to peace, east to closure.

scene6_screen10.text: (looking to the slab) Maybe the talisman will choose for us.

scene6_screen11.text: Their fingers brush. Elara kneels and lays four relics on the ancient stone: Heart-Wood Sliver, Serpent’s Eye, Frostcore Crystal, and Midnight Rune. Together at last.

scene6_screen12.text: Heart-Wood guides, Serpent’s Eye wards, Frostcore preserves truth, and Midnight Rune shapes destiny.

scene6_screen14.text: For a heartbeat the relics resist – sparking and humming – until Elara’s voice threads them together with the forebears’ chant. Light flares; the talisman forms, humming with power and wisdom.

scene6_screen16.text: Elara slips the talisman over Caspian’s neck. Magical power surges through him as the ridge trembles.

scene6_screen17.text: (soft) You faced every trial. I just carried the pieces.

scene6_screen19.text: They clasp hands, anchoring each other against the swell of power.

scene6_screen21.text: (gentle) I almost did – until you found me.

scene6_screen22.text: They stand silently forehead to forehead, heartbeats synchronized, letting silence speak.

scene6_screen23.text: Above them a comet arcs across the sky, as their joined silhouettes seem to glow. Dawn’s first blush rises on the eastern rim – proof the forest’s border is finally behind them.

scene6_screen24.text: (soft laugh) So then, legend – ready for the next chapter?

scene6_screen25.text: (warm) I write better with a co-author.

scene6_screen26.text: Hand in hand, they face the glowing horizon, the talisman pulsing between them. The stars fade, but their path – north, west, or east – now belongs to them alone.

scene6_screen27.text: The forest’s grip is broken, and the world waits. Which road will you take together? Take a quiet moment now – chat together about what unfolded, what moved you, and what paths you might choose next.
